name: Tide 2.0
description: Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs (TIDE 2.0) by MeitY promotes tech entrepreneurship by providing financial and technical support to incubators supporting ICT startups.

name: Seed Support Scheme
description: Seed support scheme providing debt/equity financing to early-stage startups with innovative ideas and technologies through recognized technology business incubators.

name: PMEGP
amount: up to 20 Lakh Services / 50 Lakh Manufacting
description: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) offers credit-linked subsidies up to 35% to set up micro-enterprises in non-farm manufacturing and service sectors.

name: NAIF Scheme
description: National Agricultural Innovation Foundation (NAIF) scheme supports agri-entrepreneurs, farmers, and agribusiness startups with financial assistance, incubation, and commercialization guidance.

name: Mudra Loan
description: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) provides collateral-free institutional credit up to ₹20 Lakh to non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises across Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories.

name: Government of Gujarat Startup Scheme
description: Gujarat Industrial Policy financial assistance for startups offering seed support, sustenance allowance of ₹20,000/month (₹25,000 for women), prototype grants, and marketing assistance.

name: ACT Grants
description: Action, Co-operation and Transformation (ACT) Grants provides non-dilutive grant capital to social impact startups and NGOs tackling India’s systemic challenges in healthcare, climate, and education.

name: Growth Grant
description: Growth Grants offer catalytic non-dilutive grant capital to student and student-founded startups to accelerate market expansion, pilot validation, and enterprise hiring.

name: Young Innovators Grant
description: Early-stage grant initiative supporting student innovators and university-led startups turning scientific research and innovative prototypes into market-ready ventures.

name: CGTMSE
entityType: Pvt Ltd / LLP / OPC / Registered Firm
description: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises provides third-party credit guarantee coverage up to ₹5 Crore for collateral-free term loans and working capital facilities.

name: Avaana – Startup India Deep Tech Grand Challenge 2025–26
description: Joint initiative by Avaana Capital and Startup India to empower early-stage deep-tech, climate-tech, and sustainability startups with up to ₹2.5 Crore in funding, strategic mentorship, and corporate pilot opportunities.

name: RKVY-RAABI Programme 2026
description: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY-RAABI) grant programme by Ministry of Agriculture offering financial support to Agripreneurs and Agritech startups for scaling commercial agricultural products.

name: STARTUP SEED SAMRIDH | Funding Opportunity
description: MeitY SAMRIDH scheme provides matching funding and acceleration support to software product startups, helping them scale operations and secure commercial venture capital.

name: Evolve-Tech
description: Equity funding opportunity targeting high-growth tech-enabled startups across B2B SaaS, FinTech, Consumer Tech, and Enterprise Solutions ready for seed and pre-series A capital.

name: GREENOVATION CHALLENGE
industry: plastic waste,texttile waste, Food waste & Circular solution
description: National sustainability challenge providing high-impact grant funding to startups innovating in plastic waste management, textile recycling, food waste reduction, and circular economy.

name: Womenpreneur for Bharat 4.0
description: Specialized grant and mentorship program dedicated to empowering women founders building scalable startups across Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across Bharat.

name: CSR MEGA GRANTS
description: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) grant pool connecting corporate foundations with Section 8 companies, NGOs, and social enterprises executing high-impact welfare programs.

name: PM SVANIDHI STARTUP CHALLENGE
description: MoHUA & Startup India initiative inviting startups to deploy technology-driven solutions for urban street vendors, including digital financial tools and eco-friendly packaging.

name: CHIPMAT
description: Strategic deep-tech semiconductor and hardware grant for startups developing cutting-edge silicon architectures, embedded systems, microelectronics, and advanced materials.

name: AOP | AFBIC – Agri-Startup Incubation Program
description: Agri-Business Incubation Centre (AFBIC) funding and acceleration program offering up to ₹25 Lakh for innovative agriculture, agri-tech, farm mechanization, and supply chain ventures.

name: BIZLABS ACCELERATOR PROGRAMME
description: Corporate accelerator offering equity-free grants, banking sandbox access, executive mentorship, and pilot opportunities with leading financial institutions.

name: STARTUP LEAGUE 2026
description: National venture league by Startup Stairs offering access to a ₹10 Crore equity investment pool, venture backing, and direct institutional investor matchmaking.

name: Gujarat Innovators
description: Dedicated state grant program nurturing homegrown innovators in Gujarat with prototype funding, patent subsidies, and academic incubator infrastructure.

industry:
Clean Technalogy

description: International catalytic grant fund investing in scalable Indian innovations addressing clean technology, healthcare access, agritech, robotics, and circular economy.

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS)
description: DPIIT-operated credit guarantee scheme providing collateral-free loans up to ₹20 Crore per borrower for DPIIT-recognized startups through member lending institutions.
